parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs of the instances from which to detach the RAM role. Array length: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: RamRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the instance RAM role to detach. You can call the RAM API [ListRoles](~~28713~~) to query the names of instance RAM roles that you have created.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
